structured_output.what_is_happening: BRAIN (Buttbrain) is a pump.fun coin that migrated to PumpSwap about 2h13m before detection. It pitches itself as an 'autonomous butt brain and token deployer', which is an AI-agent/auto-launcher theme. It pumped about 390% over 6h on $2.6M of volume and topped out near $807k market cap (ATH price 0.000807). At detection it was around $230k, roughly 71% below that peak. It fell about 28% over the last 30m and 21% over the last 5m. Hourly volume ($189k) is well under the 6h average (about $430k/h), so the trigger fired while the coin was cooling off after the peak, not while it was accelerating. At least 10 same-name copycat BRAIN tokens were launched after this one. That fits the pattern of a coin that got real attention.

narrative.description: The story is an AI agent that launches tokens and 'learns from every launch'. It sits in the AI-agent / autonomous-deployer meme category, with a crude-humor name. GMGN reports that the dev's X account has launched 306 tokens. That either fits the 'deployer' idea or points to a serial launcher.
narrative.why_spreading: It had enough attention to reach about $800k market cap, draw 7k unique buyers in 6h and spawn many copycat tokens. Activity is now falling: volume is down, price is well off the high, and unique sellers now slightly outnumber buyers over the last hour.

token_connection.why_this_token: Of the listed BRAIN/Buttbrain tokens, this pair was created earliest. It is linked to the project website and X account (buttbrainer) and has a paid DexScreener profile, so it looks like the original.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are 10+ same-name copies created later. Most show zero liquidity, and their mcap figures are meaningless. A few (B8SDEV..., 88XBn..., DU5Q...) show millions in h1 volume, which is probably wash or bot trading. These copies can split attention and confuse buyers.

authenticity.evidence: Signs of organic interest: 7,115 unique buyers in 6h, 87 smart wallets and 4 KOL wallets, top 10 holders at 16% excluding pools, dev holding 0.6%, LP 100% burned, and many copycats. Signs of promotion or manipulation: 150 paid DexScreener boosts, 1000+ bundler and fresh-wallet tags, 60% bot/degen share, bundlers at about 20% of top traders, and a 4-wallet transfer insider network. The dev's X account has launched 306 tokens.
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't see any X posts, so I can't tell whether the attention came from a real viral post or from paid boosts plus bots.

structural_risks: Price is 71% below its ATH and the downtrend is continuing; the last 5m, 15m and 30m are all red
Hourly volume is falling from the peak
Heavy bundler and bot activity could produce further dumps
The -50% stop sits at about $115k market cap, which is a plausible level for a post-peak slide
Copycat tokens are pulling liquidity and attention away
The dev's X account has a serial-launcher history (306 tokens)

structured_output.counterargument: This is the original token of a theme that clearly caught on: it reached about $800k, has thousands of buyers, burned LP, and a clean holder spread. A 70% pullback after the peak is typical, and a second leg back up is common when an AI-agent story is still live. The dev or agent may keep posting launches that pull attention back. Getting back to $460k is only about 57% of the ATH, and liquidity of $47k makes that move mechanically easy if buying returns.
unknowns: Whether the X account is still active or viral
Whether the 'autonomous deployer' product is real
Where the bundlers and insider network hold or sell
Why the price dropped over the last 30m

structured_output.thesis: This coin is the original of a theme that got real attention, but the trigger caught it after the peak: down 71% from ATH, falling over every recent window, and with volume slowing. Bundlers and bots make up a large share of trading, and many copycats split attention. Burned LP makes a liquidity pull unlikely, but a slow bleed through the -50% stop is more likely than a fresh 2x within 6h.
